run_fit_references_cli: run the fit_references script with --config and --out-path to fit linear element references
fit_linref_function: fit linear element references from a training dataset config and save checkpoints to an output path
load_config_and_fit: load a YAML config file with load_config then pass it to fit_linref for reference fitting
save_element_reference_checkpoints: save fitted element reference state dicts as .pt checkpoint files using save_checkpoint
fit_linear_references_call: call fit_linear_references with targets, dataset, batch size, and num workers to compute element references
